bead.title: bench-pr-A5: agent-leak fix + planning_mode + Go runner deactivation + parity fixtures/diff.sh
bead.description:
PROBLEM: Three cutover items: (a) the benchmark tool-preset leaks PlanningMode into the agent, which must move to an explicit profile field; (b) the Go runner's execution subcommands must redirect to ./benchmark; (c) we must prove the bash runner matches the Go runner on a committed canary before deactivation merges.

ROOT CAUSE:
- internal/serviceimpl/execute_native.go:265 reads `PlanningMode: req.PlanningMode || req.ToolPreset == "benchmark"`, leaking planning mode whenever the benchmark preset is used.
- cmd/bench/main.go dispatches execution subcommands (matrix, sweep, run, plan) into the retiring Go runner.

PROPOSED FIX:
- Delete the `|| req.ToolPreset == "benchmark"` clause at internal/serviceimpl/execute_native.go:265.
- Add sampling.planning_mode: bool (default false) to the profile YAML schema; harness-adapters/fiz reads it and appends --plan to the command when true. Spike: `rg -l 'preset.*benchmark|FIZEAU_PRESET' scripts/benchmark/profiles/` and add sampling.planning_mode: true to each profile that relied on the preset.
- Modify cmd/bench/main.go to short-circuit execution subcommands (matrix, sweep, run, plan) with the one-line redirect 'use ./benchmark — see scripts/benchmark/README.md' and exit 2; listing subcommands (profiles, bench-sets) stay functional until PR F.
- Parity: BEFORE this child's deactivation commit, run the Go runner against canary (sindri-lucebox + tb-2-1-canary, 3 reps) and commit 3 representative cell reports to scripts/benchmark/testdata/parity/go-runner/. During this child, run the bash runner on the same canary and commit cells to scripts/benchmark/testdata/parity/bash-runner/. Add scripts/benchmark/testdata/parity/diff.sh (bash + jq) reporting field divergence outside an allowlist (cell-id, timestamps, paths, NEW fields: harbor_runner_image_digest, model_server.commit, etc.).

NON-SCOPE: bash runner front end (A2); execution loop/budget/retry (A3); concurrency/signals (A4); adapters + image (A1); deleting cmd/bench entirely (PR F). Parent out-of-scope preserved: PR B schema; PR C bench-set schema; PR D collector; PR E importers; PR G docs. Governing artifact plan-2026-05-15-benchmark-runner-simplification.

DEPENDS ON: A4 (working bash runner incl. signals) and transitively A3, A2, A1. Parity capture (go-runner fixtures) must precede this child's deactivation commit.

ACCEPTANCE (satisfies parent AC4, AC6, AC7):
1. scripts/benchmark/testdata/parity/diff.sh against the committed go-runner fixtures is clean per the allowlist. TestParityDiffClean. (parent AC4)
2. `fiz-bench matrix 2>&1 | grep -q 'use ./benchmark'; test $? -eq 0` — and the command exits 2. TestGoRunnerRedirectExit2. (parent AC6)
3. `grep -n 'ToolPreset == "benchmark"' internal/serviceimpl/execute_native.go` returns nothing. TestNoToolPresetBenchmarkLeak. (parent AC7)
4. A profile with sampling.planning_mode: true causes harness-adapters/fiz to emit a command containing --plan; default false omits it. TestPlanningModeProfileField.
GATES: `go test ./...` passes; bats scripts/benchmark/test passes; `lefthook run pre-commit` passes.
bead.acceptance: Parent AC4, AC6, AC7 hold; acceptance 1-4 pass; go test ./..., bats, and lefthook run pre-commit all green.
